findings.title: D1 overstates B and C cost
D11 names PipelineCounters
A slow call that succeeds gets recorded as no_reply, and nothing owns the deadline
findings.why_it_matters: A timer stores a false outcome for slow calls that succeeded.
findings.chosen: A: Delete no_reply and any deadline
findings.recommended: A: Delete no_reply and any deadline

findings.title: Debug capture has no size limit, which contradicts the Posture and D10's own table
findings.why_it_matters: A chatty capture outruns the failsafe's shared budget, so max_size_mb stops being a limit.
findings.chosen: A: DEBUG lines don't draw on the failsafe's shared budget
findings.recommended: A: DEBUG lines don't draw on the failsafe's shared budget

findings.title: A rejected listener is evaluated once per route, so D5's promise is false today and rollups double-count
findings.why_it_matters: Domain-wide globs run predicates twice per rejected event and count two misses.
findings.chosen: A: A listener rejected on one route isn't evaluated again for that event
findings.recommended: A: A listener rejected on one route isn't evaluated again for that event

findings.title: The scope rule covers the entity pattern, but not the other filters a registration builds to select its events
findings.why_it_matters: Filtered on_call_service listeners would record every unrelated service call as a miss.

findings.title: caused_by asserts causation from a shared context id
findings.why_it_matters: The wire name claims causation on a surface that promises no conclusions.

findings.title: API write size is unstated, and D12 says rollups are the only table that can grow large
findings.why_it_matters: An unnamed cap can't be checked, and a tight writer can reach the size limit alone.
findings.chosen: A: Name the cap and state an estimate
findings.recommended: A: Name the cap and state an estimate

findings.title: The dispatch limit has no pass or fail, and no benchmark exists to measure it
findings.why_it_matters: Measure-it can't fail, so the Posture's promise is unchecked.

findings.title: D3's hard limit arithmetic is about 4.5 times too low for its own worst case
findings.why_it_matters: The bound was ratified on the expected case, not the bound.
findings.chosen: Relabel the size row; about 25 MB expected, about 110 MB at the bound; D3 and D12 re-confirmed

findings.title: The unclean-end time and the crash-loss window aren't stated
findings.why_it_matters: A crash's displayed end time is its last heartbeat, and the flush window had no length.
findings.chosen: State the heartbeat time in D2 and the flush interval in D3; both re-confirmed

findings.title: One dropped rollup flush loses a whole window for every listener
findings.why_it_matters: A dropped flush loses every listener's entries for that window.
findings.chosen: B: Accept as a known limitation
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation

findings.title: The default CLI view of an API write shows caller data
findings.why_it_matters: Audience assumption: users who paste CLI output publicly. Output can include personal content.
findings.chosen: B: Accept as a known limitation
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation
